CHW Consent Prefill v3
CHW Consent Prefill · Version 3SCN020.001 Request/Consent for Medical Procedure Treatment

Example patient filled in. These are not real details. Clear before using with a patient.

1Patient label

On iPhone, tap the Scan label box, tap it again and choose Scan Text (on newer iPhones it is under AutoFill). Point at the label and tap Insert. Or copy the label text with Live Text in the Camera app and tap Paste.

The barcode usually holds the MRN. Use Scan label for the name, date of birth and M.O.

Read on this device. Check every field against the label.

Photograph label sends the photo to Claude to read. Confirm this is allowed under SCHN privacy policy before using real labels.

Sex

2Procedure

The medical practitioner is the doctor explaining the procedure and taking consent. Their name goes in all three practitioner name boxes on the form. The form asks for no abbreviations.

Patient age box
Consent boxes crossed on the form
Tick or untick each box to match what the family agrees to.

3Practitioner signature

Sign with a finger or stylus. The parent signs their section on the printed copy.

×Sign here

4Email the form

The filled PDF is never saved to this device. It opens straight into a new email as an attachment. Copy both addresses first, then paste them into the To line.

Email 

    

    
Send from your NSW Health account only. Emailing a consent form to a family's personal address should be covered by local policy.
